notes: Play knowledge rewritten as executable actions. Every reference is checked against the generated level data by tools/gen_level_nuance.py.

Depot has the largest destroy-list in the game: its arms cache alone accounts for seventeen tagged targets, so it is the level where a bot most needs to treat an objective as a set rather than a point.

nuance.claim: The arms cache is many separate crates rather than one target, so the objective is a room to be cleared exhaustively and not a thing to be shot once.
nuance.because: Objective 0 names seventeen separate destroy tags, by far the largest such list in the game.

nuance.claim: The cache room is cleared of guards before explosives are set off, because the blast that destroys the crates will also kill anyone standing among them, including the player.
Explosives placed centrally destroy many crates per charge, so the cache is finished with a small number of well-placed mines rather than shot crate by crate.
The computer network is a screen plus terminals behind the player, so turning around after the obvious target is part of the objective.
nuance.because: Objective 1 names three separate destroy tags rather than one.

nuance.claim: The blueprints are inside the safe, so the safe key is a hard prerequisite and the two objectives are one sequence.
nuance.because: Objectives 2 and 3 are separate records and the key opens the container holding the blueprints.

nuance.claim: The safe key sits on a table in the same area as the computer terminals, so the key and the network objective are collected in one visit.
The safe is on the upper floor of the station building, so the blueprints objective requires a vertical move that a flat route will never reach.
Locating the train ends the mission, so the cache, the network and the blueprints must all be finished before heading for the garage doors.
nuance.because: Objective 4 is the level exit; unfinished objectives score as failed.

nuance.claim: The route to the train leads out of the building holding the safe and down to the garage doors, so the exit is adjacent to the last collection objective.
